Title: 500485-2026: France – Technical design services for civil engineering and building construction – Project management (maîtrise d'oeuvre) for the replacement of the Fleurville bridge over the Saône
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Replacement construction of a road bridge over the Saône in France — bridge projects are very relevant for sbp and this is a single project, not a framework agreement. Missing information on span and on the award criteria (lump-sum prices stated) slightly reduces the rating.
titel: Design services for the replacement construction of the Fleurville bridge over the Saône
kurzbeschreibung: The Département de l'Ain has awarded design services (maîtrise d'oeuvre) for the replacement construction of the Pont de Fleurville over the Saône. A design team led by QUADRIC and ARTELIA is taking over the technical design of the new road bridge.
wettbewerb_art: Award of design services (maîtrise d'oeuvre) in an open procedure
gewinner_rolle: Design team for the overall technical design (maîtrise d'oeuvre) of the replacement bridge
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value: 300430 EUR (design services)
Address: GROUPEMENT QUADRIC / ARTELIA, 14 Porte du Grand Lyon, 01700 Neyron, France
projektbeteiligte:
Client: Département de l'Ain, 45 avenue Alsace-Lorraine CS10114, 01003 Bourg-en-Bresse, France (e-mail: scprbm@ain.fr)
Designer (winner, lead partner): GROUPEMENT QUADRIC, 14 Porte du Grand Lyon, 01700 Neyron, France
Co-designer: ARTELIA (member of the design team)
Subcontractor: PHIPRIM (subcontractor in the design team)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Road bridge over the Saône, presumably more than 20 m span
- Contract covers complete technical design services (maîtrise d'oeuvre), including structural design
- Bridge projects in France are generally of interest, also as a reference market
- Structural design has already been awarded to a consortium, therefore limited potential for direct involvement
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in France, no classic German checking engineer procedure
- Contract for design has already been fully awarded, external independent checking not explicitly tendered
- For larger bridges, additional independent checks are possible, but here there are no indications of separate checking engineer services
- Medium-sized fee volume (300 kEUR) indicates limited project size
baukosten_erklaerung: estimated: typical construction costs for the replacement construction of a road bridge over the Saône with a designer's fee of approx. 300 kEUR
naechste_schritte: Do not establish direct contact with the winner for structural design, as the maîtrise d'oeuvre services have already been fully awarded. Occasionally monitor the project to see whether independent checking or expert services are tendered in later phases (monitoring of tenders by the Département de l'Ain via https://marchespublics.ain.fr/).
notes: CPV 71322000 confirms technical design services for civil engineering and building construction (including bridges). Weighting price/technical 50/50, thus also a technically oriented award. Contract term 33 months from 01/06/2026. Value of the awarded design services: 300430 EUR.
